[default]
region = ap-northeast-2

[profile acme-prod]
[profile acme-prod-admin]
[profile acme-stg]
[profile acme-stg-admin]
[profile acme-dev]
[profile acme-dev-admin]
[profile sandbox]
[sso-session corp]
sso_region = us-east-1

set -gx PATH x

# Added by AWS Pick
set -gx AWS_PROFILE "acme-prod-admin"

set -gx PATH x

# Added by AWS Pick
set -gx AWS_PROFILE "acme-prod"
